nodes.summary: If $k$ is a positive-definite kernel on a set $X$, there are a real Hilbert space $H$ and a map $\varphi : X \to H$ such that $k(x, x') = \langle \varphi(x), \varphi(x') \rangle_H$ for all $x, x' \in X$.
nodes.title: Feature map of a positive-definite kernel

nodes.summary: A function $k : X \times X \to \mathbb{R}$ on an arbitrary set $X$ is a positive-definite kernel if and only if there are a real Hilbert space $H$ and a map $\varphi : X \to H$ with
nodes.title: Aronszajn's theorem

nodes.summary: If $\varphi : X \to H$ is any map into a real inner product space, the kernel $k(x, x') = \langle \varphi(x), \varphi(x') \rangle$ is positive definite: each kernel matrix is the Gram matrix of the vectors $\varphi(x_i)$, and $\alpha^\top K \alpha = \|\sum_i \alpha_i \varphi(x_i)\|^2 \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Inner products of features form a positive-definite kernel

nodes.summary: A function $k : X \times X \to \mathbb{R}$ on an arbitrary set $X$ is a positive-definite kernel if for every $n$ and all points $x_1, \dots, x_n \in X$ the kernel matrix $K = (k(x_i, x_j))_{i,j}$ is symmetric positive semidefinite: $K^\top = K$ and $\alpha^\top K \alpha = \sum_{i,j} \alpha_i \alpha_j k(x_i, x_j) \ge 0$ for all $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}^n$.
nodes.title: Positive-definite kernel

nodes.summary: If $k$ is a positive-definite kernel on $X$, the matrix $(k(x, x'))_{x, x' \in X}$ indexed by the whole set is positive semidefinite in the sense of finitely supported vectors: it is symmetric and $\sum_{x, x'} \alpha_x \alpha_{x'} k(x, x') \ge 0$ for every finitely supported $\alpha : X \to \mathbb{R}$. Proof: such a sum is the quadratic form of the kernel matrix on the support of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: A positive-definite kernel is a positive semidefinite matrix on the whole set

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.label: statement formalized
